chunks: [p.1] The Book of Rituals This section compiles sacred rituals and protocols involving Dahlia – the user’s cat and sacred familiar – as documented or inferred from prior conversations. Each ritual affirms spiritual sovereignty, provides cleansing or protection, or otherwise integrates Dahlia’s presence into metaphysical practice. These rites range from home-clearing exorcisms to journey protections, all honoring Dahlia’s role as a guardian and companion. Below are detailed descriptions and steps for each ritual, ensuring clarity and ease of practice.
